channel.title: Commute Oncology
channel.description: A personal revision podcast on the lines of treatment for prostate, kidney and bladder cancer in England. Scripts are drafted by AI from NICE, NHS England, ESMO and RCR sources and voiced by synthetic speech. Not clinical advice: check current guidance and local protocols.

item.title: Ep 1 · Metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer and first-line kidney cancer
item.description:
Volume (Chaarted) versus risk (Latitude) in hormone-sensitive metastatic prostate cancer, and how docetaxel fitness decides which combination England funds. Then the IMDC score in metastatic kidney cancer and the first-line combinations it unlocks, including avelumab with axitinib for favourable risk.
